findings.title: 78 non-ASCII comment violations (em dashes, Vietnamese, box chars) across the-tu beta files
findings.counterexample: ratchet lists 78 violations
findings.expected: comments plain ASCII English
findings.actual: em dashes, Vietnamese names, box chars in comments
findings.rootCause: worker authored Vietnamese + box-char comments against P15
findings.repair: FIXED @bdc04bf9: de-diacritized comment lines only in 31 files

findings.title: Root mutex not re-verified at load or kit-resolution
findings.counterexample: saveShapeValidation has no excludesNode check; ordered if/else skips validation
findings.expected: excludesNode pair rejected at integrity boundary or loudly resolved
findings.actual: crafted both-roots save passes validation; resolveBodyKit silently prefers cuong_chien
findings.rootCause: validator checks ownership/coverage not mutex pairs; purchase seam is the only acquisition path
findings.rejectionReason: strict-version validator intentionally checks shape, not domain invariants; no game path can produce both-roots; consistent with F-PT-C-3 precedent

findings.title: PendingReflect key omits attacker in map key
findings.counterexample: reachable only via thrown fault aborting applyActionImpact mid-queue
findings.expected: entries keyed per holder+attacker or cleared on abort
findings.actual: key omits attacker; stale entry could merge a different attacker's hits (timing only)
findings.rootCause: no early return between queue site and flushReflects in normal flow
findings.rejectionReason: requires a thrown fault mid-apply; unreachable via normal flow

findings.title: Stale phan_chinh comments survive rename to phan_chan

findings.rootCause: comments not updated during the phan_chan rename

findings.repair: channel renamed to tranKinhWeakenRatio end-to-end; spec sec.2.4 amended @b7f4bbfc

findings.title: sourceMaxHpRatio dead field on non-physical authored deal_damage ops (validates, spreads, silently drops)
findings.counterexample: adapter spreads {sourceMaxHpRatio} onto every ActionDamageInfo branch; CombatSystem.resolveActionHit forwards it only for kind==='physical'
findings.expected: registry faults or adapter strips sourceMaxHpRatio when the resolved damage kind is not physical
findings.actual: elemental and primordial ops silently drop the field (no authored def triggers it today - forward-contract gap)
findings.rootCause: spread applied to all branches instead of physical-only
findings.repair: sourceMaxHpRatio spread gated to physical returns only @710d8012

findings.title: sacrificeMaxHpRatio/damageBonusPerPaidHpPoint on a damage===undefined def drops silently
findings.counterexample: both the pay_hp emit and the orphan report live inside `if (def.damage !== undefined)` - no else branch
findings.expected: a no-damage def carrying sacrifice fields reports() to adapterUnsupportedMetadata
findings.actual: neither op nor report produced
findings.rootCause: no else branch covering sacrifice fields on the no-damage lane
findings.repair: no-damage sacrifice-field def reports to adapterUnsupportedMetadata @710d8012

findings.title: INV-9 natural-action-source predicate duplicated inline at three+ seams
findings.counterexample: `declared.actionSource === 'normal' || 'skill'` (and negations) written inline at TBS:657, TBS:2433, TBS:3006/3034/3103, TurnSkillPlanRuntime:569
findings.expected: a single named classifier shared by the windows
findings.actual: consistent today, but a future natural source kind needs three+ coordinated edits
findings.rootCause: two-member allowlist inlined at every seam
findings.repair: isNaturalActionSource classifier replaces all inline allowlists @710d8012

findings.title: Pha Kinh bake replaces kit.basic.instances instead of merging
findings.counterexample: plain `=` assignment on the clone, no pre-check
findings.expected: merge with or assert-absent a pre-existing instances block
findings.actual: CUONG_QUYEN has no instances today so nothing is lost, but a future instances-bearing basic would silently lose it
findings.repair: instances bake merges authored block instead of replacing @710d8012

findings.title: corrupt both-roots-owned state silently resolves to cuong kit
findings.counterexample: resolveBodyKit checks cuong_chien before tran_the; a both-owned state picks cuong silently while tran minors remain purchasable dead nodes
findings.expected: impossible both-roots state fails loud or the excluded branch is inert
findings.actual: silent resolution; unreachable via legit flows (excludesNode + orphan cascade + shape validation)
findings.rootCause: no save-level check on the root pair (crafted-save only)
findings.rejectionReason: unreachable via gameplay - purchase excludesNode, respec/devReset orphan cascade, and shape validation all permit at most one owned root; only hand-crafted saves reach it (F-PT-C-3 precedent)

findings.title: TheTuTreePanel isAbandoned() omits stateVersion touch unlike sibling accessors
findings.counterexample: isAbandoned reads getNodeLevel without stateVersion.value while chosenRootId/tcReached/nodeState all touch it
findings.expected: consistent explicit reactivity dependency across accessors
findings.actual: harmless today (chosenRootId tracks the same keys) but divergent convention

findings.title: save version not re-bumped across the node-tree redesign - v84 the-tu saves die as 'corrupted' instead of 'incompatible'
findings.counterexample: v84 save with old-tree the-tu investment passes the version check then fails D9f/catalog validation as 'corrupted'; same-version saves without the-tu load fine
findings.expected: a redesign retiring persisted node ids and re-parenting grants bumps CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION per project convention (v73-v84)
findings.actual: v84 unchanged - asymmetric rejection channel within one version

findings.title: Loan Dau cast at exactly 1 HP commits with zero sacrifice
findings.counterexample: paid = min(maxHp*0.3, 1-1) = 0 -> skip -> cast fires all hits at base coefficient + max missing-HP bonus
findings.expected: design ruling: either gated below 2 HP or intentionally free
findings.actual: free cast at maximum missing-HP state
findings.rootCause: sacrifice is a cost not a gate; spec floor semantics imply pay-what-you-can
findings.rejectionReason: spec 2.3 floor semantics already pin pay-what-you-can (paid<=0 skips, cast commits); 1-HP free-cast edge now pinned in spec 2.3 addendum as intentional for beta - gating below 2 HP is a BETA-BALANCE ruling for the user

findings.title: chan_an per_target+latest ownership shadows an earlier phan_chan holder's mark
findings.counterexample: second phan_chan source's chan_an re-application replaces the first source's instance - first holder's reflect falls to base ratio
findings.expected: marked-ratio check reads this holder's own mark
findings.actual: latest-wins ownership; unreachable in single-player builds (one participant carries phan_chan)
findings.rejectionReason: unreachable in current single-player builds - only one participant can carry phan_chan; flagged for future multi-holder case

findings.title: sourceMaxHpRatio silently dropped on non-physical damage defs - no registration fault or unsupported-field warning
findings.counterexample: an authored elemental/primordial def carrying sourceMaxHpRatio passes validation and silently produces nothing - adaptDamageOp copies it unconditionally; CombatSystem applies it only on kind==='physical'
findings.expected: physical-only field follows the armorPierce+explicitlyNonPhysical precedent (contradictory_damage_policy fault) or surfaces via collectUnsupportedSkillSemantics
findings.actual: validated-but-unread field rides the op payload silently
findings.rootCause: no kind-consistency check or unsupported-semantics warning for sourceMaxHpRatio
findings.repair: non-physical def carrying sourceMaxHpRatio reports to adapterUnsupportedMetadata @c8cbf932 + regression test

findings.title: TurnSkillDisplayMeta.ts comments re-saved with stripped Vietnamese diacritics
findings.counterexample: ~40 diff lines of comment-only churn transliterating Vietnamese comments (DONG BO etc.) outside the the_tu entries
findings.expected: diff limited to the-tu metadata
findings.actual: functionally inert comment churn
findings.rejectionReason: protection rule P15 requires comments to be ASCII-only; the transliteration was the mandated P15 fix, not accidental churn - displayed strings retain diacritics correctly

findings.title: reflection profile passes through fDP/fDRP - delivered amount diverges from spec-pinned maxHp*ratio
findings.counterexample: applyModifiedDirectDamage applies finalDamageMultiplier (1+holder fDP)*(1-attacker fDRP) on the reflect amount
findings.expected: spec sec.2.5 pins amount = holder.maxHp * ratio
findings.actual: authored coefficient is exact; the shared channel multiplies fDP/fDRP before the vitals write
findings.rootCause: reflection rides the modified-direct channel (legacy phan_chinh parity)
findings.rejectionReason: spec pins the authored coefficient; post-channel fDP/fDRP is the existing convention shared with legacy phan_chinh (parity preserved) - multiplier values are BETA-BALANCE territory

findings.title: pendingReflects not keyed on rootActionId - stale entry only via mid-action exception
findings.counterexample: an exception between queue and tail flush could strand a pending entry emitting a correctly-targeted reflect under a stale rootActionId
findings.expected: pending entry drained by the same action's flush
findings.actual: no early return exists between queue and flush; carryover only via exception
findings.rootCause: defensive keying absent; control-flow shows no legitimate path
findings.rejectionReason: non-exploitable - reviewer-traced control flow shows no reachable path between queue and flush other than an engine exception; defensive-keying hygiene note

findings.title: resolveBodyKit silently prefers cuong_chien on a forged dual-root save
findings.counterexample: hand-edited v85 save with both roots levelled passes shape validation; cuong wins first check, tran mods collect inert
findings.expected: exactly-one-root at purchase/respec (verified)
findings.actual: mutex is not a save invariant; forged-save only
findings.rootCause: no save-level check on the root pair
findings.rejectionReason: duplicate of F-TT-COR-8 (crafted dual-root save - unreachable via gameplay, see F-TT-COR-8 rejection)

findings.title: spec/impl coefficient drift: CUONG_QUYEN_MULTIPLIER 1.4 vs spec sec.2.2 '1.1'
findings.counterexample: spec sec.2.2 pins coefficient 1.1; impl ships 1.4 (+27%) and the balance baseline validates the shipped build - semantic authority and impl diverged without a flag
findings.expected: spec records the tuned shipped value with a balance flag per sec.3.6
findings.actual: spec text stale at 1.1
findings.rootCause: tuned constant never written back to spec
findings.repair: spec sec.2.2 updated to 1.4 tuned value with balance flag + ward/flat-channel note @c8cbf932

findings.title: sacrifice + reflection ride flat channels bypassing ward entirely
findings.counterexample: warded caster pays through own ward; warded attacker takes unmitigated reflect (applyDamage writes currentHp directly, no ward consultation)
findings.expected: spec silent on ward interaction; sibling damage channels route through ward
findings.actual: internally consistent flat-channel semantics, plausible intent, unflagged
findings.repair: spec sec.2.3 ward/flat-channel note pinned (intentional for beta, revisit at BETA-BALANCE) @c8cbf932
